source: hand-written: derived from the Set/Get naming symmetry, NOT from a header
note: These six entry points are absent from the public nvn_protos.h. Their shapes are inferred from their siblings (WindowGetNumTextures mirroring WindowSetNumActiveTextures, DeviceBuilderGetFlags mirroring DeviceBuilderSetFlags, and the two *BuilderGetDevice getters mirroring their SetDevice siblings). verify_ios.py counts them separately so a guess is never silently folded into the verified set.
